ruleDefinitions.name: Modify Group Policy Settings
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect malicious GPO modifications can be used to implement many other malicious behaviors.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\SOFTWARE\\\\Policies\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\System.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*GroupPolicyRefreshTimeDC.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GroupPolicyRefreshTimeOffsetDC.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GroupPolicyRefreshTime.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*GroupPolicyRefreshTimeOffset.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*EnableSmartScreen.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ShellSmartScreenLevel.*")))
